Le claquant des attaques et la longueur: The snap of the attacks and the length of the tails, band by band.
ONIRIQUE PUNCH est un transient shaper m: ONIRIQUE PUNCH is a multiband transient shaper: it shapes the start and the end of every hit, with no compressor and no threshold to set.
Jusqu'à trois bandes, séparées par des f: Up to three bands, split by crossover frequencies you drag with the mouse. Each band has its own Attack, to make the start of the hits snap or round them off, its own Sustain, to stretch or shorten what follows, and its own response: Sharp for the instant of the hit, Medium with a bit of body, Smooth for broader, gentler shaping.
L'écran montre en direct le gain appliqu: The display shows the gain applied over the band's level, live. Delta lets you hear only what Punch adds or removes; stereo link keeps the image intact. On the right: input and output with their meters, Pan, Width, Mono, Phase, Swap and Mix for parallel use.
Pour les kicks qui tapent, les caisses c: For kicks that hit, snares that crack, and room sound you want to make disappear, or let breathe.
Les attaques deviennent des accords, le: Attacks turn into chords, the rest drifts into haze.
Repère les attaques fréquence par fréque: It finds the attacks frequency by frequency, then makes them ring: every hit excites a bank of resonators tuned to a chord (minor 9, Lydian, sus2…), and the whole sound leaves behind a spectral haze that slowly fades away.
